 Applications open for energy assistance programs
 Brian Weckerly 
 16 hours ago 
 As colder weather approaches, energy assistance is available to help offset winter heating costs.
 The federal Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) provides funding to assist eligible households with home energy expenses.
 Illinois LIHEAP 
 You must be a resident of Illinois and a U.S. citizen or legally admitted for permanent residence.
 You must live in the household and be responsible for paying the home energy/utility bill (or rent that includes utilities).
 Your household’s combined gross income for the 30 days prior to application must be at or below 300% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines or 60% of the State Median Income (SMI).
 To apply, Illinois residents in Rock Island, Mercer and Henry counties can contact Project NOW at 309-793-6391. Residents can also call the Illinois LIHEAP hotline at 833-711-0374.
 Iowa LIHEAP 
 Total household income for an applicant must be at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines .
 Eligible customers who need help with energy bills should apply for LIHEAP at a local community action outreach office.
 The Iowa Department of Health and Human Services has additional information about the program. Eligibility requirements information is also available by dialing 211.
 For more information on LIHEAP, click here .
